Discovery Domain · уровень 17

You gain the ability to breathe underwater, and your
Swim Speed doubles.
You always have the Tsunami spell prepared. You can also expend a use of Channel Divinity to cast it without expending a spell slot.
Aldyhn grants wisdom, Vani grants courage, and Thonir grants storms. The trick is knowing which blessing you’ve received.
—Cranhath Antonsson, Grimfolk Jarl

Автоматизация / ограничения:

  • Tsunami выдаётся на 17 уровне. Альтернативную трату Channel Divinity выбрать вручную.

source.custom: Legends of the Round Table: Chivalric Handbook
